# FLX-3122: a plan that declares a generator plugin must stage its rows

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A plugin's values are not drawn from the engine's kernel, and many models give the same bytes only in the environment that ran them, so the run of a bundle that declares generators is generated once, at plan, and its stored bytes are what apply commits. A plan made with --no-stage keeps only plan.json and leaves apply to generate again, which a plugin's run never does, so it is refused before any plugin code runs. Plan without --no-stage, or use fluxsim run, which holds its execution in memory and writes it once.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3122
```
